historical_hypotheses.comparability: No prior numeric sample was silently pooled. Historical claims are compared qualitatively because prior engine versions and smaller samples are not equivalent to this frozen V1 run.

donatello_previously_overperforming.note: Donatello is below 45% in this audited V1 environment.

first_player_advantage_previously_52_to_.note: The aggregate first-player rate is 50.64%. Canonical/reversed aggregate rates are not a seat-effect estimate because deterministic pair ordering confounds them with deck identity.

krang_previously_overperforming.note: Krang is substantially below 45% in this audited V1 environment.

leonardo_previously_underperforming.note: Leonardo is below 45%, with its 95% interval below 45%.

splinter_previously_near_or_below_50_per.note: Splinter is above 55% in this audited V1 environment; this is not a near/sub-50 result.

methodology.confidence_interval: Wilson score 95% interval for binomial deck win rates
methodology.draw_handling: draws are excluded from win-rate denominators only where present; none are expected to be silently converted to wins or losses
methodology.field_extraction: schema-directed extraction of decks, orientation, and raw winner from every audited evidence file; no game was rerun
methodology.first_player: the first deck in the evidence decks array; aggregate canonical/reversed rates are descriptive only because deterministic pair ordering confounds them with deck identity
methodology.input_integrity: the banked completion audit independently verified JSON parsing and raw-result SHA-256 integrity for all 184320 files before this analysis
methodology.unit: one distinct member evidence file equals one game; duplicate execution is authentication, not a second statistical sample

orientation_interpretation: DECK-IDENTITY CONFOUNDED — NOT A SEAT-EFFECT ESTIMATE

paired_seat_effect.method: paired block/pair contrast: +1 first player wins both orientations, -1 second player wins both, 0 outcome flips; normal 95% CI over 92160 paired observations

red_flags.engine_artifact_caution: Winner and seat orientation are descriptive outputs of the frozen engine/runtime. No card-level causal inference or deck change is authorized by this report.
